name: mstack-plan
description: Turn an approved spec into a reviewed implementation plan: phases and tasks sized for one agent session each, red-green test steps, dependencies and parallel rounds, the best installed skills named per task (with vetted online suggestions for gaps), a review of every plan (cross-vendor, or a same-vendor fallback when that reviewer is missing), a shared progress file, and an execute-plan.md that starts inline or multi-agent execution. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.
